# hdtSMP64 (Faster HDT-SMP) plugin API

`PluginAPI.h` and `PluginOwnerAPI.h` are the public plugin interface of
[DaymareOn/hdtSMP64](https://github.com/DaymareOn/hdtSMP64), copied verbatim.
They are distributed under the accompanying [GPL-3.0 license](LICENSE) and
[exceptions](EXCEPTIONS).

The copy comes from the unmerged `feat/plugin-frame-events` branch (interface
version 2.2.0, upstream pull request #480, which builds on the mesh owner
interface of pull request #479). It adds mesh owners and frame listeners to
the 2.0.0 interface. Replace it with the header from the released hdtSMP64
version once those changes are merged upstream.
